categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in adhesives and coatings, focusing on synthetic rubber, synthetic resin and plastics, industrial additives, and paints. Adhesives are mainly used in sports footwear, apparel, industrial, and consumer products, while coatings include powder coatings, liquid coatings, industrial coatings, and building chemicals. The company also develops bio-based and environmentally friendly products across these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced polymer synthesis, water-based and solvent-free adhesive technologies, UV curing, and supercritical foam material technologies. It integrates batch production methods for specialty chemicals and emphasizes green chemistry, low VOC emissions, and sustainable raw materials. The firm also utilizes global production bases for localized formulation adjustments and rapid supply.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international sports footwear brands, industrial manufacturers in electronics, semiconductors, automotive, textiles, and building materials sectors. The company serves OEM/ODM factories and brand owners globally, with a focus on high-performance, environmentally friendly adhesives and coatings. Emerging markets include medical supplies, soft packaging, and optical applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales span Taiwan, Asia, Oceania, and other global regions with production bases in Taiwan, China (Foshan, Dongguan, Kunshan, Huai'an), Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Australia, and Malaysia. The company maintains a global supply chain and customer service network to support localized production and delivery.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, producing specialty adhesives and coatings from petrochemical and bio-based raw materials. It integrates upstream polymer synthesis and downstream formulation and application services, with some vertical integration into raw material sourcing and downstream customer technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding green and sustainable product lines, increasing R&D investment in water-based, solvent-free, and bio-based materials, and developing innovative adhesives for emerging industries such as semiconductors, electronics, automotive, and medical supplies. The company emphasizes digital transformation, AI integration, low-carbon manufacturing, and global market expansion through strategic acquisitions and partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of adhesives, coatings, and specialty chemical materials. The company also derives income from technical services, customized formulations, and licensing of proprietary technologies. It maintains long-term contracts with major brands and OEMs, supporting stable recurring sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's specialty adhesives market and holds a global market share of approximately 3.62% in adhesives and 0.23% in coatings. Competitors include multinational chemical companies such as Henkel, BASF, Sika, AkzoNobel, and local firms. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D, global production footprint, and focus on sustainable, high-performance products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$22.98 billion, representing an 11.67% growth over the prior year. Operating profit grew by 21.2%, and net profit increased by 8.59%, with earnings per share of NT$22.26. The company has shown steady growth supported by product innovation and market expansion, with total assets exceeding NT$27 billion and equity of about NT$15.9 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, environmentally friendly adhesives and coatings with superior performance tailored to customer needs. It emphasizes green chemistry, low VOC emissions, and sustainable raw materials to meet global ESG standards. Its global production and technical service network enable rapid response and customized solutions, supporting customers' innovation and sustainability goals.
